newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks garner modest gains at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks garner modest gains at open.

text.p: The Australian share market made a firm start at the open on Thursday with a bounceback in the Dow heartening traders, although base metals prices dragged on some resource leaders.
The All Ordinaries index gained 6.7 points at the opening to 2,420.9.
Brokers said trade was quiet with little activity, although the overall tone remained upbeat.
"It's not that exciting so far," said broker Dirk Van der Struyf of Hartley Poynton, although he noted the continuing resilient performance from the gold sector.
"Gold is very volatile at the moment but the larger stocks are the saviours. They are really holding up the rest of the gold sector."
Plutonic shares were up six cents to A$5.21 (US$4.02), Newcrest scrip up 11 cents to A$5.10 and Acacia shares up six cents to A$2.25 were the pick from the sector.
At the small end, shares in Gawler Craton gold hopeful Desertstone fell after assay results did not meet early hopes.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about nine to five, while about 40 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
